_comment: Convergence-threshold discovery beats. When the named convergence dim crosses `threshold`, the runtime force-injects scene fields (REVELATION/BEAT) on the next turn. Each beat fires at most once per session. Beats are scaffolding — they recover the legacy engine's closing-arc pressure that thin training data underemphasizes. After the model is retrained on the expanded portfolio they may become redundant; tune lower thresholds (or remove) once the BEAT head learns to fire verdict_ready on its own.
